The review says **fix**: the new [Cleaner page](/framework/ext/Refine/cleaner/) is supposed to show a live view of the Cleaner below its demo, but that view is empty at all four widths. The diff includes a fix in `Objects.js` that was meant to make it draw, but the screenshots show it still doesn't.

All five asks in the brief are met; I couldn't check from the diff whether the progress cards were posted to `/live/` or the voice mastermind was messaged. The three notes are minor:
- On a 400 px phone, the comments in the Cleaner page's code sample are cut off on the right.
- On wide screens the Cleaner page's two demo panels stack instead of sitting side by side, so the page is mostly empty.
- The Refine page still has its long captions, which is expected because the redesign is only a proposal for now.

Full report: `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/refine-audit/review/report.md`
